title: 2000 & Life
format: Mixtape (sold in shops, e.g. Deal Real, per Link Up TV); physical format not stated

type.basis: Mixtape; Link Up TV says it mixed original beats with US hip-hop instrumentals.

sound.text: Link Up TV (2019) says it mixed original beats with well-known US hip-hop instrumentals (Kanye West's '2 Words', Mobb Deep) and showed Ghetts 'at his raw best'.
Stereogum (2016) names 2000 & Life, his 2005 debut, as showing Ghetts is 'one of the best', in an entry noting his complex, hard-hitting lyrics since his N.A.S.T.Y. Crew days.

context.text: His first release, made after leaving prison in 2003; Ghetts is from Plaistow, Newham, and was in N.A.S.T.Y. Crew before founding The Movement (Wikipedia).
Listed in Vice's 'Top 10 Mixtapes' of 2006 (published Jan 2007).
Link Up TV (2019) bought it at Deal Real, the Carnaby Street hip-hop shop, and says it 'garnered some buzz'.

rels.other: Kano feat. Ghetto - Typical Me (already in register)

uncertainty: Release year conflict: 2005 (Wikipedia, Stereogum) vs. Vice's 2006 list (which may reflect when it circulated). Label, catalogue number and format unknown. The Kanye West and Mobb Deep beats are not identified.
tracklist: 24 tracks (Wikipedia). Mixes original beats with well-known ones, including 'Poverty' over a Kanye West beat and 'Getaway' over a Mobb Deep beat (Link Up TV, 2019).
